title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live: Glow-N-Fire
address: Persiaran Putra, Bukit Jalil, 57000 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: First Asian stop of the Hot Wheels monster truck arena tour: life-size trucks such as Bone Shaker, Mega Wrex and Tiger Shark plus freestyle motocross. Five shows: Fri 16 Oct 8pm, Sat and Sun 1pm and 8pm. Tickets RM89 to RM488 on Tri-Tix. Details: https://tri-tix.com/events/hot-wheels-monster-trucks-live
cover_hint: Monster truck mid-jump inside a dark arena with glowing neon lighting and sparks

title: Malaysia Speed Festival (MSF Racing) 2026 - Round 4
address: Jalan Pekeliling, 64000 KLIA, Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia
description: Round 4 of Malaysia's grassroots racing series (Saga Cup, Myvi Cup, 86xBRZ Cup and more) on the Sepang full circuit. Paddock access RM45 for the weekend or RM20 Sunday only, bought at the North Paddock counter; parking and grandstand included. Details: https://www.msfracing.com/
cover_hint: Pack of Proton Sagas and Perodua Myvis racing side by side through a Sepang corner

title: MIAPEX 2026 - Malaysia International Automotive & Parts Expo
address: Jalan Dulang, Mines Wellness City, 43300 Seri Kembangan, Selangor, Malaysia
description: Sixth MIAPEX: about 350 exhibitors from Malaysia and abroad showing spare parts, EV aftermarket, accessories, repair tools and paint, with consumer activities such as car shows and competitions. Open 10am to 6pm. Organiser expects 22,000+ visitors. Details: https://www.bernama.com/en/news.php?id=2607549
cover_hint: Busy expo hall with modified cars on display stands and parts booths, wide angle
